name: debug
description: DEBUG BUILD (2026-10-09): exposes Konami's own in-game debug facilities that survive in SLPS_000.65 (step/sub-step/counter overlay, debug text renderers, OPTION's hidden sound test and parameter editor, the page-F scene warp) and adds a scene-select menu built on the retail step machine. The retail gates stay in the code: D_800B9710 is only forced on by the module each frame, the OPTION card-file check (BISLPS-00065F) still runs. Output: build/patch/debug/.

region.what: JIS level-1 kanji glyphs of the 12x12 font D_800BD250 (glyphs 453..3417), the same block the English profile reclaims; the debug module is ~8 KB so only the last ~450 kanji (rarest JIS level-1 codes) are lost

hooks.note: retail uploads RAM 0x801F0020 (nothing ever puts a font there on the retail disc); the hook uploads the generated 4bpp font to the same VRAM rect (704,480 64x32 words)

callsites.note: _main's frame loop `jal game_main`: game_main's first two words are a hoisted now_step load that falls into the body (func_800426F8 expects it in $v0), so a head trampoline is impossible; the call site is redirected instead and dbg_game_main calls the untouched retail game_main

pokes.note: D_800B9710 Konami debug-display flag (.data, retail 0): gates step_debug_overlay_draw, the debug text renderers, debug_font_load, the pad-2 L1+R1 VRAM viewer and R1/R2 pn_switch in _main, OPTION's L1+L2+R1+R2 debug entry (scenes 33/34). Retail sets it only when the memory-card file BISLPS-00065F exists at OPTION boot; the module re-asserts it every frame.

D_800BA280 'pn' debug text page (retail 0): the three renderers draw only when >= 4. pn_switch (pad-2 R1/R2 under the debug flag) steps 8..0; OPTION's screens call pn_set(4); NAME_ENT saves/restores it around the opening movie.
